source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of October 26, 2026, there were 1,264,975 shares (in thousands) of the registrant's common stock, par value of $0.01 per share, outstanding.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on the NYSE as CMG. The 10-Q cover for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 is the latest count and is stated in thousands (1,264,975 thousand = 1,264,975,000 shares). The 50-for-1 split took effect in June 2024, before both counts.
